after.2: v. 使合理化, 合理地解释；合理地思考

evidence: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries: rationalize verb — to find or give a logical explanation for something
词库既有人工释义 rationalize：vi. 合理地思考；vt. 使合理, 合理地处理, 使有理化
corrections.reason: 原释义「v. <主英>=rationalize」是英式拼写交叉引用，没有中文义；按 rationalize 词典义补「使合理化、合理地解释；合理地思考」。

originalRow: For instance, physics allows you to observe and rationalise the world, but also to integrate observations into models and, sometimes, models into theories or laws that can be used to make predictions.
